title: Solution Consultant
description:
**What You'll Do** **:**

* Collaborate with Sales and Engineering teams to understand customer requirements and design tailored GCP cloud solutions.
* Act as a technical consultant and trusted advisor throughout the pre\-sales, implementation, and managed services lifecycle.
* Design scalable, secure, reliable, and cost\-effective cloud architectures using GCP.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, requirement gathering, and architectural discussions with customers.
* Prepare and deliver technical presentations, solution demonstrations, architecture proposals, and POCs.
* Develop detailed Statements of Work (SOWs), including scope, deliverables, timelines, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Support Sales teams with technical estimations, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and solution positioning.
* Design and support cloud migration and hybrid cloud solutions for enterprise customers.
* Work with GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Cloud Spanner, Cloud Bigtable, and AI/ML services.
* Provide technical guidance to Engineering and Delivery teams during solution implementation.
* Ensure smooth transition of implemented solutions into Managed Services and ongoing operations.
* Support SLA management, incident management, production troubleshooting, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* Identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, scalability, security, and operational stability.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, stakeholders, Sales, Engineering, and Service Delivery teams.
* Stay updated on emerging GCP, AI/ML, Kubernetes, Terraform, and cloud technologies and bring innovative solutions to customer engagements.
* Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**What you’ll bring** :

* 8\+ years of experience in Cloud Computing, Cloud Architecture, Solution Consulting, Infrastructure, or related fields.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP); AWS/Azure experience is also considered.
* Proven experience in designing, architecting, and deploying scalable cloud solutions.
* Strong experience with cloud migration, hybrid cloud, and traditional infrastructure.
* Experience working in a Managed Services Provider (MSP) or large enterprise environment.
* Hands\-on experience with GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Cloud Spanner, or Cloud Bigtable.
* Experience with AI/ML platforms, such as Vertex AI/AI Platform, Agent platforms, or BigQuery ML.
* Strong experience with Kubernetes and Docker; AWS ECS is an added advantage.
* Experience with Terraform and cloud automation/IaC tools such as Cloud Deployment Manager, CloudFormation, or Azure Automation.
* Experience in pre\-sales, solution consulting, technical presentations, estimations, proposals, and SOW preparation.
* Strong experience in customer requirement gathering and stakeholder management.
* Experience with SLA management, incident management, RCA, and production support.
* Excellent communication, presentation, consulting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong ability to collaborate with Sales, Engineering, and Service Delivery teams.
* GCP Professional\-level certification is preferred; willingness to obtain the certification within the first 90 days is required.
* Willingness to work 12:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST to support global team and customer overlap.

Pay: ₹4,000,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Are you currently serving your notice ? OR When is your last working date?
* Years of experience with GCP cloud ?
* Current CTC?
* Current location?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bengaluru, Karnataka

title: Life Sciences – Domain Consultant
description:
About the role
  
As a Domain Strategist – Life Sciences, you will make an impact by crafting compelling, insight\-led proposals and bid responses for life sciences clients across the pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, and diagnostics sectors. You will be a valued member of the Life Sciences Business Development team and work collaboratively with Sales and Solutioning teams to map client needs to solution capabilities and communicate clear business value to clients and key stakeholders.
  
In this role, you will
  
Act as a trusted advisor to Sales and Solutioning teams, articulating the business value of Cognizant Moment solutions within the Life Sciences industry and converting client business requirements into domain\-led solution options.
  
Drive domain content for proposals and bids, including win themes, solution storyboards, qualification responses, battle cards, and competitive one\-pagers that help sales quickly articulate differentiation.
  
Stay current on the Life Sciences ecosystem of product partners and Cognizant proprietary industry solutions and accelerators, mapping client use cases to strengthen proposal differentiation.
  
Curate reusable solution assets and reference architectures that accelerate proposal turnaround for Life Sciences opportunities.
  
Contribute to Life Sciences practice offerings, case studies, and thought leadership, mentor junior BD and pre\-sales associates, and provide market intelligence on competitor positioning and emerging client needs.
  
Work model
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Bangalore, Hyderabad, or Kolkata. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
What you need to have to be considered
  
Bachelor's degree in life sciences, engineering, or business; MBA or relevant master's preferred.
  
10\-15\+ years of experience in business development, pre\-sales, or consulting, with at least 5\+ years focused on the Life Sciences industry.
  
Understanding of commercial value chains, medical affairs, patient support programs, field\-force effectiveness, and omni\-channel engagement models.
  
Functional and strategic expertise in Life Sciences CRM platforms (e.g., Veeva Systems, Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud) and digital experience portals.
  
Proven experience supporting Life Sciences pursuits, client presentations, and solution demonstrations, with strong executive presence and excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
  
These will help you stand out
  
Strong domain understanding of the life sciences industry and its technology landscape.
  
Awareness of CX, CRM, and Digital Experience concepts relevant to pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, and diagnostics clients.
  
Ability to engage consultatively across stakeholders, from sales teams to client executives.
  
Strong research synthesis and analysis skills to convert market and client insights into compelling proposal content.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Manager- Presales / Technical Sales
description:
Job Description
  
**Job Description: Presales \& Technical Resource – Microsoft Technologies**

*Location: Bangalore / Gurugram (NCR) \| Function: Presales / Technical Sales \| Industry: IT Software / Microsoft Ecosystem*

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a techno\-commercial Presales and Technical Resource with deep expertise across Microsoft Technologies to support enterprise sales cycles. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth (Level 300\) with the ability to translate customer business needs into compelling technical and commercial narratives — leading discovery, solutioning, demonstrations, and proposal development. This role sits at the intersection of technology and sales, requiring both credibility with technical stakeholders and fluency in commercial/business conversations.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Partner with the sales team through the full presales cycle — from lead qualification to solution design, proposal, and deal closure.
* Lead structured customer discovery sessions to uncover business outcomes, technology landscape, constraints, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures spanning Microsoft Copilot, Data Modernization, Fabric, Azure Infrastructure, and Security.
* Build and deliver technical presentations, live demonstrations, proofs of concept (PoCs), and proposals tailored to customer priorities.
* Respond to RFPs/RFIs with technically sound and commercially competitive solutions and business cases.
* Articulate business and technical differentiation of Microsoft solution areas relative to competitive alternatives.
* Drive deal progression by removing presales blockers, aligning stakeholders, and maintaining momentum on agreed action items.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to both customers and the internal sales team, balancing technical accuracy with commercial pragmatism.
* Stay current on Microsoft's evolving technology roadmap, licensing models, and competitive landscape.

**Required Skills \& Experience**
---------------------------------

**Technical Expertise (Level 300\)**

* Microsoft Copilot — architecture, licensing, use\-case design, and adoption scenarios.
* Data Modernization — modern data platforms, migration strategies, and data estate transformation.
* Microsoft Fabric — end\-to\-end analytics, data engineering, and integration capabilities.
* Azure Infrastructure — hybrid cloud, virtualization, App Modernization, and cloud migration patterns.
* Security — Microsoft security stack (identity, data protection, threat management) and secure solution design.

**Experience \& Attributes**

* Prior experience in a presales, solution consulting, or technical sales role within IT software or the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Demonstrated techno\-commercial capability — equally comfortable in technical deep\-dives and commercial/business discussions.
* Strong presentation, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills across technical and business audiences.
* Microsoft Technology certifications at associate/expert level (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Data Engineer, Security Engineer, or equivalent) preferred.
* Experience building business cases, ROI/TCO models, and RFP responses.
* Self\-driven and comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, competitive, quota\-influenced environment.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience with partner co\-sell motions and Microsoft funding/incentive programs.
* Exposure to enterprise sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger Sale) from a presales perspective.
* Prior experience in industry\-specific solution positioning (BFSI, Manufacturing, Retail, etc.).

*This role can be based out of Bangalore or Gurugram (NCR) and requires close collaboration with sales, delivery, and Microsoft partner teams to drive technically credible, commercially sound opportunity progression.*


  
Qualification
  
**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. MBA is a plus.
